about: P37A T1 dev set: 150 juror-style sentences written on 2026-10-03 without access to the sealed test set – 60 unknown-verb, 40 non-game, 30 fantasy, 20 mix (short, typos, two verbs). Same checklist rules as evals/play/fidelity/corpus.json (2-4 nouns, exactly 1 verb, written before any run).
